specialty_retail_niche.value: Online surplus asset and excess inventory auction marketplaces (circular economy / reverse logistics)

merchandise_specialization.value: Surplus industrial equipment, vehicles, IT, medical and lab equipment, and retail and consumer goods inventory across hundreds of categories

retail_selling_format.value: Multi-marketplace online auctions with self-service, full-service or hybrid models, including sell-in-place; sellers are enterprises and governments

purchase_refill_cadence.value: Non-recurring, opportunistic auction purchases tied to seller surplus availability; sellers run ongoing or planned programs

online_sales_penetration.value: Essentially all sales transacted through online auction marketplaces

product_specific_regulatory_exposure.value: Compliance requirements for regulated surplus such as biopharmaceutical, medical equipment and vehicles, plus government-sale and audit documentation
